items.description: Validator SSH and model-name regexes are broad (emails can look like SSH; opus/sonnet/haiku match non-model prose).
items.resolution_condition: Tighten detectors without false positives on constitution/policy prose; add focused negative tests.
items.defer_reason: Not required for workflow/graph/quality kernel. YAGNI for Plan 2.

items.description: JSON/TOML under upstream/ besides vendor-lock.json is not parse-validated.
items.resolution_condition: Doctor/release validation walks imported upstream machine files without treating them as canonical policy.
items.defer_reason: Vendor copies are locked by content hash; Plan 2 does not change upstream import.
items.resolution_description: _check_parseable now walks upstream/ for .json/.toml belonging to the imported contract. Paths with an examples or fixtures segment are skipped as intentional malformed fixtures. Invalid locked machine config FAILs. vendor-lock.json remains covered.

items.description: nexus-frontend modes still name some legacy entrypoints (interface-review, explain-interface, web-design-guidelines, design-taste-frontend).
items.resolution_condition: Replace leftover names with canonical skills/upstream paths when adapters render frontend routing.
items.defer_reason: Routing copy, not workflow kernel. Unique heuristics already inlined.

items.description: migrate CLI --dry-run is a no-op (store_true with default True).
items.resolution_condition: Expose explicit --apply vs default dry-run without changing fail-closed cleanup.
items.defer_reason: Cleanup already dry-run-first; Plan 2 does not extend migrate.
items.resolution_description: Removed the fake --dry-run flag. Public migrate is preview-only. generate_cleanup_report stays dry_run True by default; --apply-tempfile is explicit opt-in for tempfile copy. Destructive cleanup is never implicit.

items.description: Unique heuristics listed in docs/migration/unique-heuristics.md are not fully materialized into the v4 tree.
items.resolution_condition: Each pending extract copied, discarded with rationale, or blocked explicitly before source deletion.
items.defer_reason: Extract remains gitignored input. Spec forbids deleting divergent skills until unique content is preserved.
items.resolution_description: Closed remaining unique-heuristics rows (implement, code-review, tdd-workflow, root-cause-tracing, napkin) as PRESERVED, ALREADY_COVERED, or DISCARDED_WITH_REASON. Unresolved divergent decisions = 0. nexus-quality SKILL.md no longer has a pending extract section.

items.description: core/workflow/completion.toml is not fully applied at runtime: required_approvals_recorded is unread; DONE_NOT_SHIPPED and shipping_is_not_implied are not distinct completion results.
items.resolution_condition: evaluate_completion reads completion.toml; missing required approvals fail closed; READY_TO_SHIP stays distinct from DONE_NOT_SHIPPED; shipping is never implied by DONE.
items.defer_reason: Resolved: completion.toml is loaded at runtime, required approvals fail closed, and READY_TO_SHIP remains distinct from DONE_NOT_SHIPPED.

items.description: evidence JSONL append is not atomic; Evidence does not persist base_commit required by spec §9 / evidence.toml.
items.resolution_condition: append_evidence uses the same atomic replace pattern as save_task_state; each record stores base_commit plus existing command/exit/diff_hash/artifact/limitation.
items.defer_reason: Ledger write path was out of this review-fix scope; freshness already keys on diff_hash.

items.description: Ratchet and budget metrics fail-open when baseline is None; ratchet.toml [budget] default_tolerance is unused.
items.resolution_condition: Missing baseline is fail-closed for required ratchet/budget metrics, or documented as explicit bootstrap; default_tolerance is applied when Metric.tolerance is unset.
items.defer_reason: Changing fail-open would break current quality tests and needs a policy ruling. Not a Done Gate freshness bug.
items.resolution_description: Required ratchet/budget without baseline is BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED, not silent PASS. Optional metrics may be NOT_APPLICABLE. Budget mode applies [budget] default_tolerance when Metric.tolerance is unset. quality-report schema enumerates the new statuses and allows null tolerance.

items.description: Trivy normalize: unknown severity is counted nowhere; HIGH secret without Resolution does not block; non-dict payload is unhandled.
items.resolution_condition: UNKNOWN/INFO severity is counted or rejected; HIGH secrets follow policy; normalize_trivy fail-closes on non-object payloads.
items.defer_reason: Scanner edge cases are not required to close the Done Gate hash bind. Trivy-only kernel already blocks CRITICAL and HIGH-with-fix.
items.resolution_description: normalize_trivy fail-closes on non-dict payload and malformed Results. Unknown severity is counted as unknown and FAILs. HIGH secrets without Resolution block via high_secret_blocks in policy.toml. Counts include critical/high/medium/low/info/unknown.

items.description: conflicts() is exact-path only (prefix write conflicts remain); ready_nodes() does not compose with conflicts(), so concurrent writers can both be ready.
items.resolution_condition: Prefix/directory write overlap is a first-class conflict; ready_nodes excludes unresolved conflict pairs unless a merge strategy is declared.
items.defer_reason: Resolved: write paths normalize trailing separators, detect directory-boundary parent/child overlap, and ready_nodes excludes all unresolved conflicting pending writers.

items.description: Stage 5 (implement) does not require a GitHub Issue; only the Done Gate checks issue when tracking_required.
items.resolution_condition: If project-tracking requires an Issue before implement, advance_stage(5) fail-closes; otherwise document that Issue is a Done Gate-only check.
items.defer_reason: Resolved: implementation-bearing Stage 5 transitions require a positive issue id when tracking_required is enabled; no issue is created.

items.description: Operational completion fields (quality_gate, security_gate, review_gate, verified/reviewed hashes, findings, evidence, skip_reason) are not in task-state schema or TaskState.to_dict. Load is fail-closed (no false DONE) but has no roundtrip.
items.resolution_condition: Extend task-state.schema.json (R8) and persist those fields through save/load so a READY_TO_SHIP state survives restart without reconstructing gates in memory.
items.defer_reason: Resolved: operational completion fields are explicit in the schema and survive TaskState save/load roundtrips.

items.description: resolve_contradiction exists but recall does not auto-exclude vs CURRENT_REPO.
items.resolution_condition: search_memory/session_recall apply resolve_contradiction so memories contradicted by CURRENT_REPO are excluded or downranked.
items.defer_reason: Resolved: explicit caller-supplied AuthorityContradiction claims exclude contradicted memories from recall injection.

items.description: Capsule stale-warning section has no own char budget.
items.resolution_condition: STALE/CONFLICT WARNINGS has a dedicated char budget distinct from hot/warm.
items.defer_reason: Warnings currently append without a section budget. Not required to close Plan 2.5 HIGH findings.
items.resolution_description: CapsulePolicy.stale_warnings_max_chars (default 2000) is loaded from retrieval-policy.toml. STALE/CONFLICT warnings truncate deterministically with a count summary (… and N more). HOT/WARM/COLD budgets are unchanged.

items.description: load_portfolio_memories still reads orphan JSON sidecars; project store no longer does.
items.resolution_condition: Portfolio loader requires complete md+json pairs, matching project store §37.
items.defer_reason: Resolved: load_portfolio_memories skips JSON without sibling .md via store._is_complete_pair.

items.description: session_recall still raises on schema-invalid JSON objects (KeyError/enum); only MemoryStoreError and JSONDecodeError degrade to empty capsule.
items.resolution_condition: session_recall catches all sidecar parse/model errors and returns an empty capsule plus a structured finding.
items.defer_reason: Corrupt non-JSON already degrades. Schema-invalid objects are doctor FAIL, not the happy path.

items.description: Empty base_commit on Evidence is accepted by the Done Gate; completeness of evidence identity is not fail-closed.
items.resolution_condition: evaluate_completion / promote_acceptance reject evidence without base_commit when policy requires a bound commit, without changing READY_TO_SHIP semantics for already-complete evidence.
items.defer_reason: Controller left Done Gate semantics unchanged in the Plan 3 final-review fix wave.
items.resolution_description: Mutable completion evidence requires a non-empty base_commit. commit_independent=True or command static-policy/policy-file remains independent. Visual evidence and playwright capture fail closed without a real commit. READY_TO_SHIP meaning for already-complete valid evidence is unchanged.

items.description: PreToolUse production and destructive detection is substring matching on tool/path/command/url, not a command parser. Equivalent encodings can slip past until a structured command policy exists.
items.resolution_condition: Canonical production/filesystem/network policies are evaluated against a parsed command/argv model, still fail-closed on invalid sensitive payloads.
items.defer_reason: Repair gate closed the no-op PreToolUse and fail-closed invalid payloads. A parser is Plan 4 CI/VPS policy depth, not required to stop READY_TO_SHIP on string PASS reports.
items.resolution_description: PreToolUse now classifies CommandIntent from argv (preferred) or shlex-parsed command strings, unwraps sh/bash/zsh -c wrappers, and applies production/destructive policy to executable/subcommand intent. Prose such as echo production documentation is not treated as production. Malformed sensitive commands fail closed. Parser does not execute commands.

items.description: harness.lock generated_hashes includes the compiled engine copy under dist/src/nexus_harness, so any engine byte change churns the lock even when render_all() adapters are unchanged.
items.resolution_condition: Split adapter hashes from engine hashes, or hash only render_all() outputs plus a single engine archive digest.
items.defer_reason: Non-empty generated_hashes and installable engine were the repair requirement. Hash partitioning is release hygiene.
items.resolution_description: generated_hashes now covers render_all() adapters plus dist/core/*. engine_hashes covers dist/src/nexus_harness/*. validate.py reports adapter vs engine drift separately. write_lock persists both keys. Fresh checkout with dist only .gitkeep remains deterministic.

items.description: GitHub hierarchy parent_issue/child_issues is not persisted in TaskState; restart recovery relies on GitHub/Project authority rather than local TaskState roundtrip.
items.resolution_condition: Either persist hierarchy references in TaskState or explicitly prove and document GitHub as the sole recoverable hierarchy authority across restart.
items.defer_reason: Does not affect Plan 6 frontend visual quality or bounded Issue tracking.
items.resolution_description: Choice B: GitHub is the sole recoverable hierarchy authority. TaskState does not persist parent_issue/child_issues. recover_hierarchy reads GitHub-shaped input after restart. Module docstring in hierarchy.py documents the ownership split.

items.description: A failed recapture does not invalidate prior VisualEvidence still fresh for the same diff_hash; leftover desktop/mobile bundles can keep completion READY.
items.resolution_condition: Failed capture for a route/viewport must drop or mark stale the previous VisualEvidence for that pair on the current diff_hash, with a focused test.
items.defer_reason: Failed capture no longer promotes new evidence; leftover prior PASS on the same hash is restart/retry hygiene, not the abc→def freshness proof.
items.resolution_description: Failed capture appends attempt_ok=false records with captured_at. visual_completion_reasons uses newest attempt per (route, viewport, diff_hash); newest FAIL wins over older PASS. Screenshots are not promoted on failure. History is retained rather than replaced.

items.description: Visual reviewer_status is optional glue; evaluate_completion does not require a fresh visual-review PASS if screenshots are fresh and no confirmed high findings were attached.
items.resolution_condition: Material visual tasks require recorded visual-review PASS bound to current_diff_hash, or an explicit structured skip, with a test that omitted review fails completion.
items.defer_reason: Confirmed blocker/high already fail via Plan 2 findings; forcing review presence is workflow Stage 6 policy, not the visual freshness kernel.
items.resolution_description: visual_completion_reasons() now requires reviewer_status == PASS for every required viewport that counts toward Completion. None, empty, FAIL, PENDING, and unrecognized statuses fail with 'visual review is not PASS'. Generic review_gate cannot substitute. Structured is_valid_visual_skip() is unchanged. Stale evidence still fails. No second Done Gate.

items.description: PostHogConfig is secret-bearing and generic dataclass serialization may expose personal_api_key if future Harness code calls dataclasses.asdict().
items.resolution_condition: CLI, logs, doctor, reports, exceptions, and JSON output serialize PostHogConfig only via an explicit safe serializer (safe_dict / safe_serialize). Source and tests prove the injected token never appears. Do not monkeypatch dataclasses.asdict.
items.defer_reason: repr() and safe_dict() already redact; asdict() is a Python dataclass hazard, not a Plan 7 functional blocker.
items.resolution_description: Added nexus_harness.serialize.safe_serialize/dumps_report as the canonical report path. PostHogConfig.safe_dict remains the type-specific serializer. CLI/doctor helpers emit only redacted JSON. Source scan forbids asdict on PostHogConfig. dataclasses.asdict is not monkeypatched; tests document that it still leaks and must not be used.
